messages:
alex: rolled strict_validate to canary-7 at 06:10 and we're seeing a new class of fncall fallbacks where adapter returns an object with extra fields -> validator bails and we fallback. small billing uptick too.
tasha: short example?
alex: log snippet:
```
{"req":"req_x9","route":"canary-7","fncall":"normalize_v3","adapter":"node-adapter@2.1.0","validator":"v0.14","result":"fallback","reason":"extra_fields_unexpected","tokens_billed":27}
```
build-bot: Alert fired: fncall_fallbacks_total > 30 in 20m (canary-7)
ops_rene: two immediate asks: 1) standardize the reason enum (extra_fields_unexpected -> extra_fields), 2) decide billing attribution: bill to original route or to "fallback executor"?
billing_ana: if we bill to fallback executor that will change customer charges mid-request and confuse quotas. prefer billing to original route unless fallback invokes a separate paid tool.
tasha: UX problem in Console: customers just see "Function fallback" with no signal whether it was validation coercion, adapter bug, or model shape. support gets tickets asking for refunds.
alex: quick mitigation I suggest:
- emit new metric label: fncall_fallbacks_total{route,reason=extra_fields|partial_json|malformed,origin=adapter|validator|model}
- surface a Console pill: "fallback (validator: extra_fields)" with hover text explaining billing and severity
- short mute of billing alert for canary-7 for 45m while we iterate
billing_ana: agree to mute, but please also create a billing log entry for the window so we can reconcile later.
ops_rene: migration plan: emit new labeled metric in parallel with old one for 48 hours. update dashboards and alert queries to use new label.
tasha: Console change: I'll add an icon + tooltip and a link to the schema diff. small front-end PR; shouldn't take long.
alex: engineering note: validator should attempt a best-effort coercion path for extra fields (ignore unknown keys) but only in permissive mode. For strict validate we keep current behavior. Maybe we need a per-route permissive toggle rather than global strict.
build-bot: CI: validator PR opened by alex (PR #4123).
ops_rene: action items: alex -> PR to emit labeled metric + add permissive toggle RFC; tasha -> Console pill + schema-diff link; billing_ana -> log billing mute window and prepare reconciliation; ops_rene -> mute alert for 45m and monitor.
billing_ana: acknowledged. I'll also flag downstream quota tests to ensure no double-counting.
tasha: I'll test Console copy with CS before deploy.
alex: starting the small rollout revert plan if fallback rate doesn't drop in 30m. posting updates here.
build-bot: Running synthetic load test against canary-7 started at 7443211125
ops_rene: thanks all. will watch metrics and bring this to the next incident retro if needed.
